faqs.question: How does this online Python compiler work?
faqs.answer: This online Python compiler runs directly in your browser using client-side WebAssembly technology (Pyodide). Your Python 3 code executes locally inside your browser without sending your code to any remote server.

faqs.question: Which Python version is supported?
faqs.answer: The compiler supports Python 3.11+ syntax, including async/await, f-strings, match-case statements, type hinting, and popular standard modules (math, random, json, re, datetime, collections).

faqs.question: Can I take user input (input()) in Python?
faqs.answer: Yes, interactive input prompts and mock standard input (stdin) parameters are fully supported for terminal and command-line style programs.

faqs.question: Is this Python compiler completely free?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is 100% free with unlimited executions, zero subscriptions, and no registration or sign-up required.

faqs.question: Does code execution require an external backend server?
faqs.answer: No. Python executes entirely inside your browser using the Pyodide WebAssembly runtime. Your code and inputs never leave your device.

faqs.question: Can I access local files or network sockets?
faqs.answer: Due to standard browser WebAssembly security sandboxing, raw POSIX sockets and native OS file access are blocked. In-memory virtual file systems (MEMFS) are supported.

faqs.question: Which Python standard library modules are supported?
faqs.answer: Core modules including math, json, re, statistics, itertools, datetime, collections, and random are fully supported.

faqs.question: Why does the initial run take 2 to 3 seconds?
faqs.answer: On your first execution, the browser downloads and initializes the Pyodide WebAssembly binaries (~12MB). Subsequent executions run instantly from local cache.

faqs.question: How does this online Python compiler work?
faqs.answer: This online Python compiler runs directly in your browser using client-side WebAssembly technology (Pyodide). Your Python 3 code executes locally inside your browser without sending your code to any remote server.

faqs.question: Which Python version is supported?
faqs.answer: The compiler supports Python 3.11+ syntax, including async/await, f-strings, match-case statements, type hinting, and popular standard modules (math, random, json, re, datetime, collections).

faqs.question: Is this Python compiler completely free?

faqs.question: A execução precisa de servidor na nuvem?
faqs.answer: Não. Python roda no navegador através do WebAssembly Pyodide. Seu código e variáveis nunca são enviados para servidores externos.

faqs.answer: O sandbox de segurança do navegador bloqueia sockets e acesso a discos físicos. Um sistema de arquivos em memória é suportado.

faqs.question: Quais módulos da biblioteca padrão estão ativos?
faqs.answer: Módulos essenciais como math, json, re, statistics, itertools, datetime e random funcionam perfeitamente.

faqs.answer: O navegador precisa inicializar os binários WebAssembly do Pyodide na primeira vez. As execuções seguintes ocorrem em milissegundos.
